This notice is a reminder for travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Notice to Travelers

Travelers must confirm animal travel details before departure and present a suitable crate or carrier for review. Safety takes priority over speed on every journey, and staff will check each case carefully before acceptance. Please keep all papers ready and follow boarding guidance without delay.

For pet cats, the crate must meet cabin rules and allow secure movement without crowding. <<FACT F067>> Pack water, a familiar blanket, and any approved care items in a clean, labeled carrier. If you are traveling with a reptile, <<FACT F078>> and all supporting documents must be in order before check-in.

Please arrive prepared, keep the animal calm, and follow staff directions at the airport. For help with any travel detail, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
